O.content: The title reads "Kidney vs Liver Transplants," and the horizontal axis is labeled "Year" with a visible tick labeled "2017."

O.location: rightmost plotted position at the 2017 tick
O.content: A blue solid-line endpoint and a red square marker are drawn at the same visible position.
"Kidney" is printed in blue on the left side of the plot, and "Liver" is printed in red on the right side.

B.text: If the blue solid series is the Kidney series and the red dashed square-marked series is the Liver series, and coincident marks at the same year encode equal transplant volume, then their 2017 volumes are matched. If the routing labels are intended to map matched volumes to matched-volume review, that route applies; the chart does not itself print this routing policy.
B.conditions: Applies to the 2017 marks; assumes the color-coded side labels bind the series and that the route wording reflects the comparison result.
